headline: PR #2202 is 67% faster at incremental universe sync
detail: Cursor-based delta sync against the enumeration sync it replaces, measured on the same build so nothing but the algorithm differs. Discovering 5 new leaves in a 406-leaf root took 234 ms with delta sync against 718 ms with enumeration, a 3.1x speedup. A cold full sync of 855 leaves came out 8.5% slower (14.80 s against 13.64 s), which is expected: with an empty cursor nothing has been seen, so there is no discovery to skip. With nothing new at all both paths finish in about 18 ms.
caveat: Not a comparison against v0.8.1. The PR branches from main, which is 194 commits ahead of v0.8.1, so measuring against the release would credit all of those to this PR. The control is the PR's own --universe.no-delta-sync flag, which forces the old algorithm on the same binary.
